name: message-parts
title: Message Parts
description: What an agent's answer is made of beyond its text: steps, a plan checklist, status and notice lines, changes with Undo, a hand-off divider, sources, the disclaimer, actions, a version switch and a fold.

meta.whenToUse: An agent's turn in a chat or a comment thread, composed inside MessageContent: what it did, what it changed, where the answer came from.
meta.whenNotToUse: The row layout (Message), a person's message (Bubble with align end) or a single tool chip on its own (ToolCallChip).
